text: The main road near Ameerpet metro station has been flooded for 3 days after the rains. School buses cannot pass.
Ameerpet daggara road paina neellu nindipoyayi, school pillalu vellalekapotunnaru. Konni rojula nunchi ilage undi.
Rugnalayat panyachi tuti aahe. Rugna warsha divas panyavina raahtat.
The district hospital has had no water supply for two days. Patients are struggling.
Sadak bahut kharaab hai, gaadiyon ko chalane mein bahut dikkat ho rahi hai, kai accident ho chuke hain.
Road near the market has huge potholes causing frequent accidents. Needs urgent repair.
Kudineer kidaikala, pala naatkalaaga pipe pazhudhu, makkal romba sirumapadraanga.
No drinking water for several days due to a broken pipeline. Residents are severely affected.
